summary: Form checkbox with slotted label, optional supporting text and an indeterminate state.

usage.text: The indeterminate attribute is a display and ARIA state only. A user toggle clears it, and it does not change what the form receives.
The required attribute is satisfied only while checked.

a11y.text: An aria-label on the host overrides the slotted text as the name. Text in the supporting slot is visible but is not linked as the input's description.
